entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Li Yueming is a Chinese former volleyball player who won a bronze medal in the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul and competed at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona. She also won a silver medal with the Chinese team at the 1990 FIVB World Championship in China.
